visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width photograph with two white cards side by side over its lower part
visualCharacteristics.layout: large top-left radius; cards 4 + 8 of 12 columns on desktop, stacked on mobile; a card with a link list puts the list beside the text from 744px

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background <picture> (single cell); row 2: left card cell (eyebrow, text, CTA link) | right card cell (eyebrow, heading, <ul> of links)

usage: Closing "stay in touch / join us" band of the New Graduates page.
reuseGuidance: Use for card pairs over a photo; the photo belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.
